name: cadl-editor-tools
description: Build and test CADL syntax highlighting for VS Code and Zed

scripts.test: npm run generate && node scripts/test-vscode.mjs && node scripts/test-tree-sitter.mjs
scripts.build:vscode: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('build', {recursive: true})" && cd vscode && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out ../build/cadl-0.1.0.vsix
scripts.build: npm run test && npm run build:vscode && npm run build:zed
